A '''man''' was accused of the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the [[Unidentified Alderaanian nobleman's son|son]] of a famous [[Unidentified Alderaanian nobleman (murdered son)|nobleman]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and the man was incarcerated for the crime during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, when the victim's journal was discovered, the journal exonerated the alleged killer, and the victim's father ensured that the man was freed.<ref name="Lost Memories" />
